verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a Version History feature that lets users preview all saved versions, track changes, and restore/recover earlier file states, plus manually save new versions ([spline-docs-15],[spline-docs-29],[spline-docs-33]). However, there is no evidence of explicitly naming/labeling milestones or a side-by-side compare view between versions. Missing for 10: explicit naming/labeling of milestone versions, a diff/compare UI between versions, independent hands-on confirmation of restore workflow.
